errors.text: The proposed structural mediator is speculative Laves/B2 intermetallic precipitation and an Al2O3/MgO scale, whereas the target mechanism involves uniformly distributed oxide barrier phases such as AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3.
The hypothesis treats 950 °C as the predicted optimum rather than reconstructing the 1000 °C optimum.
The oxidation experiment is conducted at 400 °C instead of the target condition of 900 °C, so it does not test the relevant high-temperature biphasic parabolic oxidation behavior.

The failure experiment uses 1050 °C despite the stated processing limit of 1000 °C, and the proposed boundary of 1020 °C conflicts with the target boundary that temperatures above 1000 °C cause unacceptable Mg volatilization.
The experiment omits passive-film electrochemistry and corrosion testing in 3.5 wt% NaCl, preventing evaluation of chloride penetration resistance and polarization behavior.
